title: Early Morning Sunwatch
text:
🌅 Early Morning Sunwatch — November 05, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B6.7)
🔥 Latest solar flare: B9.1 (Peaked November 05, 2026 at 06:12 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 328 km/s (Calm)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 1.67)
🚨 NOAA Watch: Geomagnetic Storm Category G1 Predicted

Everything looks pretty calm. 🌎

A few bright active regions and a long dark filament-like feature stand out on an otherwise relatively quiet Sun.

Image: NASA SDO/AIA — 94 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
